title: Insulin Pump Program Pharmacy Coordination Clause: Pump Insulin Counted for Cartridge Refills
content:
**Clause.** For a cartridge or reservoir refill on an Insulin Pump Program, the counting of the customer's pump insulin follows the customer's Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program — the customer's active insulin pharmacy program whose delivery method is insulin pump — in three cases:

(a) where the active pump-delivery program is on any tier other than the Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program, the standard counting is replaced with its rapid-acting 10 mL vial dispensing (insulin aspart and insulin lispro 10 mL vials), each vial holding 1000 units of insulin (the vial insulin);

(b) where the customer holds no active pump-delivery program, no pump insulin is counted;

(c) otherwise the standard counting from J1817 dispensing, at 50 units of insulin per billing unit, stands.

| Customer's insulin pharmacy programs | Counting |
|---|---|
| Active program on the Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program, delivering by insulin pump | replaced with 10 mL vial dispensing at 1000 units per vial |
| Active Part B Pump Insulin program | the standard J1817 counting stands |
| Active program delivering by pen only | no pump insulin is counted |
| Insulin pharmacy program on hold, delivering by insulin pump | no pump insulin is counted — it is not active |

*Hypothetical conversion:* 2 vials are 2,000 units of insulin; 45 J1817 units are 2,250 units.
